knownDifferences.reason: the pinned handler has no try/catch; a request without api_server throws inside the async handler and the pinned process exits. GoTavern answers 500 and keeps serving. Recorded, not replayed.

the two generate routes proxy live provider streams (SSE and Ollama JSON-frame streams) with cancellation, retry and per-api-type body filtering; transcribe-audio needs multipart upload and a transcription peer; chat-completions/status is a 380-line source matrix. Each needs its own oracle and harness, so they are deferred rather than faked.
